name: imf_get_databases
description:
List the IMF databases these tools know, with their names (IFS International Financial Statistics, WEO World Economic Outlook, BOP Balance of Payments, DOT Direction of Trade and others). A fixed list; no network call.
Returns: databases (code, name) and count.
Inputs: none.
Use a code as the database argument of imf_get_dataflows, imf_get_data or imf_compare_countries.
Example: {}

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
metadata.note: Discover IMF databases including IFS, WEO, BOP, FSI, and more.
